body: The catalogue just grew to 262 items with 218 fighters. 86 new fighters landed in one wave: Juri, Laura, Urien and the Street Fighter cast, K', Angel and Vanessa from KOF, Wolverine, Magneto, Doom, Deadpool and the Marvel vs Capcom arcade legends, plus Batman, Superman, Wonder Woman, Darkseid and 18 more DC heroes and villains. Four oversized fighters join through the new Oversized Fighters Pack: Ash Crimson in true KOF XIII HD, Makoto, Shazam and Poison Ivy. Fightcade 2.7 is out too: every session now deals random stages and random music from everything you have installed, and gamepad skin switching works properly, with Settings showing the skin your buttons are wearing.
title: 90 new fighters + Fightcade 2.7
